capabilities.name: Domestic payments from the user's own account

IN.licence: RBI authorisation to operate a payment system (PSS Act s.4); non-bank payment aggregator authorisation if collecting and settling for merchants (Rs 15 crore net worth at application, Rs 25 crore by FY3); payment gateway without funds out of scope (PA MD 10(g))
IN.partner_model: bank, authorised PA or UPI PSP bank; QED initiates from the user's own account, never pools (R7 CUS-01)
IN.kyc_aml_sanctions: partner CDD under KYC Directions 2025; UNSC, UAPA and WMD list screening; originator and beneficiary data at Rs 50,000 and above

US.licence: money transmission (FinCEN MSB 31 CFR 1022.380; state licences) if QED receives and transmits funds; not if the user's bank or a licensed processor initiates and QED never holds funds (Analysis; legal review)
US.partner_model: originating bank under Nacha rules, or a processor
US.kyc_aml_sanctions: partner BSA/AML and customer identification; OFAC SDN with the 50% rule
US.data_residency: no general federal localisation; GLBA; state privacy laws

UK.licence: payment institution or EMI authorisation (PSRs 2017, EMRs 2011), PIS registration, or agent of one
UK.partner_model: FCA-authorised PI, EMI or TPP; banks may refuse a TPP on fraud risk
UK.kyc_aml_sanctions: MLRs 2017; UK Sanctions List only since 28 Jan 2026; APP reimbursement on Faster Payments
UK.data_residency: UK GDPR transfer rules; India not adequate

EU.licence: PSD2 PI or EMI authorisation (passported) or PIS registration
EU.kyc_aml_sanctions: AMLD now, AMLR from 10 Jul 2027; EU consolidated list; payee name check under the PSR once in force
EU.data_residency: GDPR Chapter V; no India adequacy decision

SG.licence: PSA 2019 services: domestic money transfer, account issuance, e-money issuance; standard or major payment institution licence by volume (classes and thresholds NV)
SG.kyc_aml_sanctions: MAS Notice PSN01 (NV); MAS targeted financial sanctions (NV); E-Payments User Protection Guidelines from 16 Dec 2024
SG.data_residency: PDPA transfer limitation; no general MAS localisation (NV)

AE.licence: CBUAE retail payment services licence (RPSCS Regulation 2021); Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 Art 62 reaches technology platforms facilitating licensed activities, reconciliation by about 16 Sep 2026; DIFC and ADGM separate
AE.partner_model: CBUAE-licensed PSP or bank; whether QED falls under Art 62 needs counsel
AE.kyc_aml_sanctions: federal AML/CFT law and goAML (NV); UN and local terrorist lists (NV)
AE.data_residency: CBUAE payment and personal data localisation (S); PDPL (NV)

GL.partner_model: partner of record per jurisdiction in the registry (proposed N-022)
GL.kyc_aml_sanctions: sanctions-screening hook before payee creation and every payment; multi-regime list registry (R7 SAN-01, SAN-04)
GL.data_residency: data-residency tag per record; region-pinned storage (R7 PRV-07)

capabilities.name: Agent-initiated payment delegation through an institution-recognised channel (credential-based agents excluded everywhere)

IN.licence: mandate debits initiated by the payee's PSP; UPI Circle delegation only for NPCI-authorised software; NPCI agent protocol reported, unpublished
IN.partner_model: e-mandate (UPI AutoPay, card, e-NACH) via regulated partner; caps fixed at mandate creation because debits ignore other customer limits (N-004)
IN.kyc_aml_sanctions: partner KYC; liability under RBI directions; from 1 Jan 2027 customer negligence includes careless use of credentials

US.licence: no open-banking payment-initiation rule; ACH debit authorisation through an originating bank (Nacha, NV); card agent tokens via networks and issuers (S); credential-based agents carry the customer's risk under bank terms
US.partner_model: ACH originator partner or card agent-token programme

UK.licence: PIS through an authorised TPP; commercial VRP via UK Payments Initiative participants since 2 Jun 2026
UK.kyc_aml_sanctions: MLRs; APP regime (coverage of agent-deceived payments unresolved)

EU.licence: PIS with strong customer authentication per payment; no commercial VRP standard found
EU.kyc_aml_sanctions: AMLD/AMLR; payee name check under the PSR once in force

SG.licence: no agent-payment channel found in sources read
SG.kyc_aml_sanctions: MAS notices; EUPG (version Verified); Shared Responsibility Framework (S)

AE.licence: CBUAE Open Finance Regulation: Service Initiation licence, or deemed for existing licensees

GL.partner_model: channel adapters derive mandate, VRP or token parameters from the signed instruction, never wider (N-016); revocation reaches every channel and records acknowledgements (N-017); agent identity (N-021)
GL.kyc_aml_sanctions: exact-term passkey approval as an additional control (D3 layer 2)

IN.licence: AA data user (FIU) must be registered with and regulated by a financial sector regulator; AA may not support transactions
IN.partner_model: regulated FIU partner; QED cannot be the FIU itself
IN.data_residency: DPDP (core duties from about May 2027); payment-data localisation

US.licence: no licence for data access as such; section 1033 stayed (29 Oct 2025) and under reconsideration; FCRA if used for eligibility (NV)
US.partner_model: aggregator agreements on FDX consent grants (scope, expiry, acknowledged revocation)

EU.licence: AISP registration (PSD2); PSR permissions dashboard agreed, not in force

SG.licence: no mandatory open-banking regime found; voluntary bank APIs (NV)

AE.licence: Open Finance Regulation Data Sharing licence or deemed licensing

GL.partner_model: consent-artefact store (purpose, scope, expiry, revocation history); deletion of QED-held data on revocation

IN.licence: authorised person for forex (FEMA s.3, NV); LRS USD 250,000 per FY, no margin; TCS; PA-CB for cross-border collection
IN.partner_model: AD-bank partner; PA-CB partner for foreign payers
IN.kyc_aml_sanctions: originator and beneficiary data; LRS declarations
IN.market_data: ECB reference rates free with citation, never executable (R5)

US.licence: money transmitter licence or bank; remittance transfer rule (Reg E subpart B) for providers; retail forex under CFTC/NFA (NV)
US.market_data: New York Fed reference rates with attribution (R5)

EU.licence: PI or EMI authorisation; Transfer of Funds Regulation for crypto

SG.licence: cross-border money transfer service under the PSA; money-changing licence for notes

AE.licence: CBUAE licence (retail payment services); exchange houses and banks

GL.partner_model: corridor registry with partner per corridor
GL.kyc_aml_sanctions: travel-rule fields on payment records (R7 KYC-06)
GL.market_data: reference rates never labelled executable (R7 DAT-05)

capabilities.name: Holding client money (wallet balances, stored value, safeguarding)

IN.licence: PPI authorisation (Rs 5 crore rising to Rs 15 crore; escrow at a scheduled commercial bank; full-KYC PPI Rs 2 lakh); PA escrow; BUDS Act bars unregulated deposits (NV)
IN.partner_model: balances at a bank or PPI issuer, shown from reconciled statements

US.licence: state money-transmitter licence or bank; FDIC pass-through rules for FBO accounts (NV)
US.partner_model: balances at a bank or licensed transmitter

UK.licence: EMI authorisation with safeguarding; CASS for investment money

SG.licence: account issuance or e-money issuance under the PSA; safeguarding for major payment institutions (NV)

GL.partner_model: ledger shows partner-held balances with source and time; unreconciled difference refuses execution (R7 CUS-01)

capabilities.name: Stablecoin or digital-asset custody, exchange and transfer

IN.licence: PMLA reporting entity if exchanging, transferring, safekeeping or administering VDAs for others (S.O. 1072(E)); FIU-IND registration; 30% tax and 1% TDS
IN.partner_model: FIU-registered exchange partner; counsel on whether a mandate-bounded agent key makes QED a reporting entity (R7 Q2)
IN.kyc_aml_sanctions: FIU-IND 2026 guidelines: liveness, geolocation, travel rule, wallet screening
IN.data_residency: CERT-In logs; VDA records five years
IN.market_data: CoinDCX owner-only (V, R5); Coinbase owner-only (S); Binance terms unread (S)

US.licence: state money-transmitter licences or NY BitLicense (NV); bank or trust custody (NV); payment stablecoins only from GENIUS-permitted issuers once the OCC rule is effective 18 Jan 2027 (S)

UK.licence: FCA MLR registration now; FSMA cryptoasset regime from 25 Oct 2027 (gateway 30 Sep 2026 to 28 Feb 2027); financial promotions regime
UK.kyc_aml_sanctions: MLR travel rule (NV); UK Sanctions List

EU.licence: MiCA CASP authorisation; transitional period ended 1 Jul 2026; e-money tokens only from credit institutions or EMIs (NV)
EU.partner_model: authorised CASP; reverse solicitation read narrowly
EU.kyc_aml_sanctions: Transfer of Funds Regulation travel rule (NV); AMLR

SG.licence: DPT service licence under the PSA (dealing, exchange, transmission, custody); FSMA Part 9 from 30 Jun 2025 for services provided from Singapore abroad, MAS reportedly generally not licensing (S); MAS stablecoin framework (NV)

AE.licence: VARA (Dubai) or SCA (federal) virtual-asset licence; DFSA/FSRA in free zones (NV); Payment Token Services Regulation: dirham tokens licensed, foreign tokens registered and payable only for virtual assets (S)
AE.partner_model: VARA, SCA or free-zone licensed provider
AE.data_residency: payment-token provider data in the UAE unless approved (S)

GL.licence: smart accounts on test chains only (chain id 31337, R7 CUS-05)
GL.partner_model: venue registry with registration evidence (R7 VDA-02)

capabilities.name: Brokerage of equities, ETFs and funds (execution, order transmission)

IN.licence: SEBI-registered broker; MF via execution-only platform (category 1 or 2) or AMFI distributor on MFU, BSE StAR MF or NSE NMF II; retail algo framework for broker APIs; no pooling
IN.partner_model: registered partner; exclude listed equities from v1 (R7 3.6)
IN.kyc_aml_sanctions: PAN and KRA KYC; folio bank account
IN.market_data: AMFI NAV personal non-commercial only (V, R5); NSE/BSE data via licensed vendors (NV)

US.licence: broker-dealer registration (Exchange Act s.15(a)) or introduction to a clearing broker
US.partner_model: broker API partner (Alpaca paper verified in R5)
US.market_data: exchange and SIP data under vendor agreements; non-professional subscriber terms (NV)

UK.licence: FCA Part 4A permissions (arranging, dealing) or appointed representative

EU.licence: MiFID II investment firm or tied agent

SG.licence: capital markets services licence for dealing (SFA) or exempt

GL.partner_model: order model with registered-route adapters; ISIN-named deterministic owner instructions (R7 INV-02, INV-03)

capabilities.name: Investment advice, suitability and discretionary management

IN.licence: SEBI RIA for personalised advice, AI use disclosed, responsibility for AI output (reg. 16C), risk profiling and suitability; discretion needs PMS (Rs 50 lakh minimum; PRIM Rs 25 lakh from 1 Apr 2027)
IN.partner_model: RIA partner reviewing model proposals (N-006 built; off in this build)

US.licence: investment adviser registration (SEC or state); internet adviser exemption amended 2024; Reg BI if a broker-dealer recommends

UK.licence: FCA permission to advise or manage; COBS suitability

EU.licence: MiFID II advice or portfolio management with suitability; AI Act Art 50 transparency

SG.licence: financial adviser licence (FAA); MAS digital advisory guidelines (NV)

AE.licence: SCA, DFSA or FSRA advice licence (NV)

GL.partner_model: rule-only suggestions labelled apart from model proposals; adviser review queue (server/adviser.ts); model holds no authority (D9)

IN.licence: banking licence; BUDS Act bars unregulated deposit schemes
IN.partner_model: show the owner's own bank products; QED pays no return (R7 CUS-04)

US.licence: bank charter; FDIC rules on representing deposit insurance (NV)
US.partner_model: partner bank sweep or deposit products

IN.licence: settlement through an authorised PA's escrow; a PA may not carry out marketplace business (10(b)); sellers onboarded (13(f)); e-commerce rules; GST TCS 0.5%; operator TDS; Social Security Code aggregator contribution (Conflict)

US.licence: state escrow licensing in some states, or marketplace or payment-facilitator model via a processor; money-transmission agent-of-payee exemptions (NV)
US.partner_model: processor; counsel on state escrow law

UK.licence: payment service unless the commercial-agent exclusion applies (narrow) (NV)

EU.licence: payment service under PSD2 (commercial-agent exclusion narrowed)

SG.licence: possibly account issuance or domestic money transfer under the PSA if funds are held (Analysis)

GL.licence: proof escrow on the local chain for test tokens (F-049)
GL.partner_model: escrow states mapped one-to-one to partner escrow or split-settlement calls (R7 CUS-02)

IN.licence: income data via AA through a regulated FIU; credit information companies under the CIC Act (NV); employer payroll duties (EPF, TDS on salary; NV)
IN.partner_model: regulated FIU partner; payroll through the employer's bank

US.licence: FCRA duties if furnishing or using consumer reports for eligibility (NV); payroll processors may be MSBs unless exempt (NV)

IN.sanctions: UNSC lists daily; UAPA and WMD orders
IN.data_residency: RBI payment-data localisation; DPDP s.16 (no country notified); CERT-In logs 180 days in India
